portal_hypertension.abstract: The purpose of these expert practical recommendations is to provide an updated, clinically oriented overview of the screening, diagnosis, treatment, and surveillance of portal hypertension in cirrhosis. Building on recent advances in the understanding and management of portal hypertension, this review summarizes evidence-based strategies for the identification and management of clinically significant portal hypertension in patients with advanced chronic liver disease, in line with the recent Baveno VIII consensus recommendations. portal_hypertension.abstract: The diagnosis and management of liver cirrhosis and portal hypertension have been challenging for hundreds of years, placing a tremendous burden on medical and social resources. In routine practice, clinicians usually depend on various documented scoring and stratification systems to establish the diagnosis and make decisions. These systems have traditionally been constructed through manual review of retrospective data, image interpretation, and statistical analyses. portal_hypertension.abstract: To evaluate long-term cardiovascular effects following insertion of a transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) in patients with cirrhosis-induced portal hypertension. In this prospective intra-individual study from 11/2018 to 5/2022, patients underwent combined hepatic and cardiac MRI before and at 1 year after TIPS insertion. Cardiac MRI included volumetric and functional assessment, strain analysis, T1 mapping, T2 mapping, myocardial edema, and late gadolinium enhancement (LGE). Hepatic and splenic imaging included T1 mapping, T2 mapping, and MR elastography-based liver stiffness.
